notes:
The estimate is a tab now.

- **Estimate** sits beside Ask NXG and Takeoff at the top of the side panel and
  opens the full-size estimate. Done (or Esc) brings you back to the tab you
  were on. The "Open estimate" button at the foot of the takeoff is gone.

- **Overlay** moved to the top of the Takeoff tab, where it is found without
  scrolling past the takeoff.
